**Finding: compliant (at fallback)** — ASSIGN, ¶(h) (p0072).

The assignment clause is mutual: neither party may assign without the other's consent (not to be unreasonably withheld), but either party — including AP — may assign **without consent** to an affiliate, to a purchaser of all or substantially all assets relating to the subject matter, or to a successor by merger, stock sale or consolidation. That delivers the M&A/affiliate carve-out we need.

I also checked the termination provisions (p0016): termination is limited to post-Initial-Term convenience notice, material breach and insolvency events — there is **no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right** against AP anywhere in the document, so neither walk-away trigger is present.

Noted but not redlined (minor sub-elements only): the clause is symmetric rather than one-way in our favour, it lacks an express prohibition on Kubient assigning to an AP competitor, and there is no written-notice mechanic for permitted assignments. No redline proposed.
